option_relations.rationale: Non-tuberculous mycobacterial sinusitis is a distinct diagnosis from Sinonasal tuberculosis caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
The option 'Tuberculosis (Extrapulmonary, Sinonasal TB)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Sinonasal tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis)'.
Nontuberculous mycobacterial infection (e.g., Mycobacterium avium complex) is a broader category of infection by different mycobacteria than Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which causes tuberculosis.
Mycobacterium chelonae sinusitis is a specific type of non-tuberculous mycobacterial infection, distinct from Sinonasal tuberculosis caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
